content.short: 246 Club sources and extends credit to high-yield opportunities, powered by Aave Re-Lending.
content.description: 246 Club sources credit and extends it to high-yield opportunities, building on Aave through what it calls Re-Lending. It operates as a lending protocol on Plasma, where stablecoin-heavy liquidity makes credit strategies a natural fit. The model layers a credit decision on top of an established money market rather than building a new pool from scratch.
